summary: Test parses a file-scoped spec carrying all four coverage tags and asserts the parsed kind/globs/command for each, asserts REQ-001.2.2 for both zero- and two-keyword items, asserts removed===true for the exact 'REQUIREMENT REMOVED' text and false (plus a keyword violation) for 'REQUIREMENT REMOVED for now', and repeats every one of these against an equivalent legacy REQ-900 spec for parity; scratch mutations disabling tag parsing, the keyword rule, or the tombstone for file-scoped specs each fail it.
